name: Mini Rise
summary: A music mini bar you pull up into the full player, with the cover flying into place as a record spins out
about: A phone music app whose little now-playing bar is really the full player folded small. Pull it up and the panel grows under your finger, the cover flies from the bar to the middle of the screen, the library sinks back and the room fills with the song's colours. Playing slides a spinning record out from behind the cover; pausing tucks it away and shrinks the art a touch.
how: Tap a song in the library to play it: the mini bar hops and its little level meter starts dancing.
Drag the mini bar up (or tap it) to open the full player; it follows your finger and springs open or shut when you let go.
Scrub the line to jump in the song, use next and back, shuffle, repeat and the heart; the cover slides to the new song and the colours glide.
Drag the big player down anywhere, or use the arrow at the top, to fold it back into the bar.
Keyboard: Tab to the bar and press Enter to open, Space plays or pauses, arrow keys move the scrubber and Escape closes.
